cohortPacks.periodAlignment: reportDate for periodic forms; explicit quarter-ended date from earnings exhibits; unresolved otherwise
cohortPacks.overflow: New container by document, then whole subheading/paragraph boundaries; indivisible oversized blocks remain unpacked and are never truncated
cohortPacks.evidence: Validated only against the target sourceId; context from other documents is not valid target evidence

requiredCoverage.exhibits: Preserve all substantive earnings EX-99 documents, including main release and supplement
requiredCoverage.actuals: Same metric, scope, period, unit, accounting basis and currency basis as guidance
requiredCoverage.consensus: Point-in-time provider estimate with publication timestamp; null when unavailable
requiredCoverage.availability: Filing acceptance timestamp and conservative post-close handling
requiredCoverage.cohortAlignment: Match accession, reportDate and eventTs. Never pair independently selected latest forms. Latest-per-company mode is extraction smoke only; full history is required for guidance vintages and actual outcomes.

timingModel.eventTime: SEC filing acceptance timestamp; conservative post-close classification when exact time is unavailable
timingModel.latencyPolicy: EOD prices cannot establish minute/hour latency. Immediate reaction is measured, never assumed tradable. Intraday claims require timestamped intraday data.

earlyPostEvent.entry: only after the first executable close and all feature timestamps

models.preEventRisk: Exposure and expected-move risk only; the unreleased report is never an input
models.immediateReaction: Descriptive event study, not an executable signal
models.postEventResidual: Uses only information available after the first executable close; predicts later residual reversal or continuation
models.interReportFundamental: Separate long-window model with macro and subsequent-disclosure confounding controls

timingModel.nullReaction: A valid null outcome; no signal and no forced position
timingModel.overreactionDefinition: Residual reaction after controlling for compatible guidance, consensus, segment and financing revisions; a large price drop alone is not mispricing

validation.multipleTesting: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across primary endpoints and preregistered event windows

biasChecks.lookAhead: Only information public by event cutoff; labels carry exitDate
biasChecks.survivorship: Current universe is a limitation and production blocker
biasChecks.sameWindowConfounding: Record macro and other company disclosures; do not claim clean causality by default
biasChecks.execution: No after-hours commentary treated as an executable close fill
biasChecks.consensusVintage: Never use a later consensus estimate as the pre-event expectation
biasChecks.guidanceVintage: Never compare actuals with a revised guidance value published after the original target was set
biasChecks.postEventFeatureCutoff: First-reaction returns are features only for positions entered after that reaction is observable
biasChecks.overlappingWindowInference: Use autocorrelation-aware inference for overlapping drift windows
biasChecks.tuning: No sealed-holdout tuning; failed and null results remain in output
